As a credit rating analyst, the issuer's financial profile presents severe credit risks: a highly constrained liquidity position evidenced by a very low current ratio of 0.55 (current liabilities exceed current assets by $382M), a highly leveraged capital structure with a liabilities-to-assets ratio of 71%, and very low bottom-line profitability (net income of $67M on $1,823M in revenue, representing a net margin of just 3.7%), which severely limits its ability to cover short-term obligations or service debt from organic cash flow. This combination of an immediate working capital deficit, high leverage, and weak net earnings places the issuer deep into speculative-grade territory with an elevated risk of default.

DECISION: B-
